items.title: 馬斯克證實洽談Terafab合作 台積電ADR漲近3% 創收盤新高
items.title_en: Musk Confirms Talks on Terafab Partnership; TSMC ADR Rises Nearly 3% to Record Closing High
paras: 台積電 (TSM-US) 與馬斯克旗下 Terafab 晶片製造計畫洽談合作，帶動台積電 ADR 週一 (5 日) 勁揚 2.75%，收在 485.80 美元，創歷史收盤新高。馬斯克已證實雙方正在討論，但合作尚未定案；分析師認為，台積電與英特爾 (INTC-US) 可能分別承接這項大型計畫的部分工作。
外媒報導，馬斯克上週六 (3日) 在社群平台 X 回應台積電參與 Terafab 的消息時表示：「目前只是討論，但可能會有進展。」另一則貼文形容 Terafab 規模將極為龐大，台積電提供的任何產能都將屬於補充，馬斯克也回覆認同。
這波合作消息源自科技新聞記者Tim Culpan 創辦的 Culpium。該平台上週五 (9日) 報導，雙方正討論由台積電興建並營運一座專供特斯拉 (TSLA-US)、SpaceX (SPCX-US) 與 xAI 使用的晶圓廠。
Culpium 指出，最可能的合作架構是由台積電持有並營運工廠，SpaceX 則投入資金、承諾採購量，或同時採取這兩種方式。不過，這些仍是討論中的方案，尚未形成正式協議。
台積電 ADR 週一高升近3%，報每股 485.80 美元，創歷史收盤新高，換算價為3086.77元，折溢價率達 19.87%。
瑞穗證券交易部分析師 Jordan Klein 認為，台積電在大規模先進製程晶片製造領域具領先地位，與 Terafab 合作具有合理性。他推測，台積電評估在德州設立新製造基地的消息，可能與這項計畫有關，馬斯克旗下企業則可能成為主要客戶。
Klein 也認為，Terafab 的工作可能由台積電與英特爾共同承接，或分別負責不同部分。
英特爾今年 4 月加入該計畫，週一股價下跌 2.63%，收在 116.19 美元。Wedbush 分析師 Matt Bryson 則在合作消息傳出後，重申台積電「優於大盤」評等。
技術分析來看，台積電 ADR 已突破杯型底部的 479 美元買點，相對強弱線同步創高，支持這次突破走勢。不過，股價目前已高於 50 日均線逾 10%，加上 10 月 15 日將公布財報，短線仍可能進入整理。
台積電預計週四公布的 9 月營收，將是市場接下來觀察營運動能的重要指標。
paras_en: TSMC (TSM-US) is in talks with Elon Musk's Terafab chip‑manufacturing project, pushing the TSMC ADR up 2.75% on Monday (the 5th) to $485.80, a historic closing high. Musk has confirmed the parties are discussing a deal, though nothing is finalized; analysts say TSMC and Intel (INTC-US) could each take on portions of the large‑scale project.

According to foreign media, Musk responded on X last Saturday (the 3rd) to news of TSMC’s involvement in Terafab, saying, “It’s just discussion right now, but there could be progress.” Another post described Terafab’s scale as massive, noting any capacity TSMC provides would be supplemental, a sentiment Musk agreed with.

The partnership news originated from Culpium, founded by tech reporter Tim Culpan. The platform reported on Friday (the 9th) that the two sides are discussing a TSMC‑built and operated fab dedicated to Tesla (TSLA-US), SpaceX (SPCX-US) and xAI.

Culpium said the most likely structure would have TSMC own and run the plant while SpaceX supplies funding, commits to purchase volumes, or does both. These ideas remain under discussion and no formal agreement has been reached yet.
The TSMC ADR surged nearly 3% on Monday, trading at $485.80 per share, a record closing high, equivalent to NT$3,086.77, with a premium/discount rate of 19.87%.

Jordan Klein, an analyst in the trading department of Mizuho Securities, believes TSMC’s leadership in large‑scale advanced‑process chip manufacturing makes a Terafab partnership logical. He speculates that TSMC’s evaluation of a new manufacturing base in Texas may be tied to this project, and that Musk’s companies could become major customers.
Klein also noted that Terafab work could be split between TSMC and Intel, each handling different components of the effort.
Intel joined the project in April, and its stock fell 2.63% on Monday, closing at $116.19. Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson reiterated TSMC’s “outperform” rating after the partnership news broke.

From a technical standpoint, the TSMC ADR has broken above the $479 cup‑bottom buying point, with the relative strength index hitting new highs, supporting the breakout. However, the price is now more than 10% above its 50‑day moving average and, with earnings due on October 15, the short‑term may see some consolidation.
TSMC’s September revenue, slated for release on Thursday, will be a key gauge for the market to assess the company’s operational momentum going forward.

items.title: 美光512GB DDR5亮相！9200MT/s、功耗降逾60% 直攻AI伺服器記憶體需求
items.title_en: Micron Unveils 512GB DDR5 Module: 9200MT/s, Over 60% Power Reduction Targeting AI Server Memory Demand
paras: 美光科技(MU-US)宣布成功展示512GB DDR5 RDIMM伺服器記憶體模組, 傳輸速率最高達9200 MT/s, 並透過先進DRAM封裝技術大幅提高單條記憶體容量與能源效率。美光表示, 這款模組可協助資料中心因應人工智慧(AI)、資料分析、記憶體資料庫及高效能運算等工作負載快速增加的需求。
美光指出, 512GB DDR5 RDIMM已在多個伺服器平台完成展示, AMD(AMD-US)與英特爾(INTC-US)目前均積極進行平台驗證。以24個記憶體插槽的雙路伺服器計算, 單一系統最多可配置12TB DDR5記憶體, 讓大型資料集能夠更多留存在主記憶體中, 減少資料在記憶體與較慢儲存層之間搬移所產生的延遲與成本。
在效能方面, 這款512GB RDIMM最高可達9200 MT/s。美光表示, 相較於由4條128GB RDIMM組成的配置, 單條512GB模組的運作功耗降低逾60%。其中, 512GB模組功耗約16W, 4條128GB模組合計則約44.2W。
美光表示, 512GB RDIMM採用先進垂直互連封裝技術, 將DRAM晶粒透過矽穿孔(TSV)進行垂直堆疊, 在單一DRAM封裝中提高記憶體密度, 同時維持現代資料中心所需的效能與穩定性。
對於受記憶體容量與頻寬限制的工作負載, 美光稱512GB RDIMM相較於256GB DDR5配置, 在以Spark支援向量機(SVM)為基礎的資料分析工作中, 效能最高可提升至1.4倍。此外, 512GB模組也能應用於RocksDB及Redis等記憶體密集型資料庫與快取平台, 提升吞吐量、並行處理能力及資料集擴充效率。
美光認為, 大型語言模型(LLM)、代理型AI、即時推理及高核心數CPU工作負載快速成長, 正推升資料中心對更高記憶體容量、更大頻寬及更低功耗的需求。高容量記憶體可讓更多資料直接保留在主記憶體, 降低資料移動需求, 對AI與大型資料分析工作尤其重要。
美光預計512GB DDR5 RDIMM將於2027年下半年依客戶需求進入量產。這意味著目前產品仍處於展示、驗證及導入階段, 實際大規模部署時間仍取決於伺服器平台驗證與客戶需求。
這項產品推出之際, 全球記憶體市場正面臨供應緊張。SK海力士(SK-HY-US)執行長郭魯正7月曾表示, 2027年可能成為記憶體產業供應情況最糟糕的一年, 客戶需求將持續高於公司供應能力, 而供需缺口甚至可能延續至2030年以後。
美光近期也表示, AI資料中心需求持續推升記憶體需求, 公司預期2027年及2028年的記憶體供需狀況將比2026年更加緊張。報導指出, 美光已看到大量客戶承諾, 長期供應合約金額持續增加, 反映AI基礎設施建設仍是記憶體需求的重要驅動力。
供應緊張也已反映在消費級DDR5價格。德國3DCenter發布的9月記憶體價格指數顯示, DDR5平均價格較2025年7月基準已升至544%, 9月單月再上漲11.9%。其中, 2x16GB DDR5-6400 CL30套裝單月價格暴漲103%, 2x32GB DDR5-6000 CL28套裝上漲33%, 2x24GB DDR5-6400套裝上漲12%。
3DCenter數據同時顯示, 不同DDR5產品的漲幅差異明顯。8GB DDR5/5600+相較2025年7月上漲400%, 16GB DDR5/5600+上漲462%, 32GB DDR5/5600+上漲488%, 32GB DDR5/6400+上漲401%, 顯示記憶體價格上行已從高階產品逐步擴散至主流容量。
相較之下, DDR4價格在9月反而下跌。3DCenter的DDR3/4整體價格指數較2025年7月基準為292%, 9月單月下降3.1%, 與DDR5持續上漲形成明顯對比。
記憶體價格與供應壓力也開始影響終端電子產品。Reuters此前報導, Fairphone、Jolla及Framework等規模較小的手機與筆電業者, 已開始透過重新設計主機板、提前採購、增加零組件測試及準備不同硬體方案等方式應對記憶體短缺。對部分約400美元的手機而言, 記憶體成本占物料清單(BOM)比例已升至約60%。
Counterpoint則預期, 記憶體供應危機將成為2026年全球智慧手機市場下滑的重要因素。該機構最新預測顯示, 全球手機出貨量今年可能年減約12%, 降至略低於11億支, 創2013年以來最低水準, 而供應緊張預計延續至2027年。
對記憶體產業而言, AI伺服器與資料中心需求正在改變傳統DRAM市場結構。三星電子(005930-KR)近期表示, HBM明年可能占全球DRAM晶圓產能近30%, 高於目前約20%, 由於HBM與一般DRAM共享部分晶圓產能, HBM擴產可能進一步限制標準DRAM供應。
在此背景下, 美光512GB DDR5 RDIMM的價值不只是單純增加單條記憶體容量, 更在於以更高密度及更低單位功耗支撐AI與資料密集型伺服器。隨著2027年量產時間接近, 這類超高容量伺服器記憶體能否大規模導入, 將成為資料中心降低記憶體瓶頸與能源成本的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US) announced the successful demonstration of a 512GB DDR5 RDIMM server memory module with a peak transfer rate of 9200 MT/s, leveraging advanced DRAM packaging technology to dramatically increase per‑module capacity and energy efficiency. Micron says the module can help data centers meet the rapidly growing demands of AI, data analytics, in‑memory databases, and high‑performance computing workloads.

Micron noted that the 512GB DDR5 RDIMM has already been showcased on multiple server platforms, with both AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) actively conducting platform validation. In a dual‑socket server with 24 memory slots, a single system can be configured with up to 12TB of DDR5 memory, allowing larger data sets to reside longer in main memory and reducing latency and cost associated with moving data between memory and slower storage tiers.

In terms of performance, the 512GB RDIMM can reach up to 9200 MT/s. Micron said that compared with a configuration of four 128GB RDIMMs, a single 512GB module cuts operating power by more than 60%. The 512GB module consumes about 16 W, whereas the four‑module 128GB configuration totals roughly 44.2 W.

Micron explained that the 512GB RDIMM uses advanced vertical interconnect (TSV) packaging, stacking DRAM dies vertically through silicon‑through‑holes to increase memory density within a single DRAM package while maintaining the performance and reliability required by modern data centers.

For workloads limited by memory capacity and bandwidth, Micron claims the 512GB RDIMM can deliver up to 1.4× higher performance than a 256GB DDR5 configuration in Spark‑based support vector machine (SVM) data‑analysis tasks. The 512GB module also benefits memory‑intensive databases and caching platforms such as RocksDB and Redis, boosting throughput, parallelism, and data‑set scaling efficiency.

Micron believes that rapid growth in large‑language models (LLM), agent‑type AI, real‑time inference, and high‑core‑count CPU workloads is driving data‑center demand for higher memory capacity, greater bandwidth, and lower power consumption. Larger memory capacity lets more data stay directly in main memory, reducing data movement—a factor especially critical for AI and large‑scale analytics.

Micron expects the 512GB DDR5 RDIMM to enter volume production in the second half of 2027, based on customer demand. This means the product is still in the demonstration, validation, and early‑adoption phase, and large‑scale deployment timing will depend on server‑platform qualification and customer orders.

The launch comes as the global memory market faces tight supply. SK Hynix (SK-HY-US) CEO Lee Suk‑Jin said in July that 2027 could become the worst year for memory‑industry supply, with customer demand outpacing the company’s capacity and the gap potentially extending beyond 2030.

Micron recently also noted that AI data‑center demand continues to push up memory needs, and the company expects the memory supply‑demand balance in 2027 and 2028 to be tighter than in 2026. Reports say Micron has seen a surge in long‑term supply contracts, reflecting that AI infrastructure construction remains a key driver of memory demand.

The supply crunch is already reflected in consumer‑grade DDR5 pricing. Germany’s 3DCenter September memory price index shows the average DDR5 price has risen to 544 % of the July 2025 baseline, with a further 11.9 % increase in September alone. Notably, a 2 × 16 GB DDR5‑6400 CL30 kit jumped 103 % month‑over‑month, a 2 × 32 GB DDR5‑6000 CL28 kit rose 33 %, and a 2 × 24 GB DDR5‑6400 kit climbed 12 %.

3DCenter data also highlight divergent price gains across DDR5 SKUs. An 8 GB DDR5‑5600+ module is up 400 % since July 2025, 16 GB DDR5‑5600+ up 462 %, 32 GB DDR5‑5600+ up 488 %, and 32 GB DDR5‑6400+ up 401 %, indicating that price pressure is spreading from high‑end products to mainstream capacities.
In contrast, DDR4 prices fell in September. The combined DDR3/4 price index was 292 % of the July 2025 baseline, decreasing 3.1 % month‑over‑month, a stark contrast to the continued rise in DDR5.

Memory price and supply pressures are also affecting end‑user electronics. Reuters previously reported that smaller phone and laptop makers such as Fairphone, Jolla and Framework are coping with the shortage by redesigning motherboards, pre‑ordering components, expanding testing and preparing alternative hardware solutions. For some phones priced around $400, memory costs now represent roughly 60 % of the bill of materials.

Counterpoint forecasts that the memory supply crisis will be a major factor in the expected decline of the global smartphone market in 2026. Its latest outlook projects worldwide smartphone shipments could drop about 12 % this year to just under 1.1 billion units—the lowest level since 2013—and that tight supply will likely persist into 2027.

For the memory industry, AI servers and data‑center demand are reshaping the traditional DRAM market structure. Samsung Electronics (005930-KR) recently indicated that HBM could account for nearly 30 % of global DRAM wafer capacity next year, up from roughly 20 % today. Because HBM shares wafer capacity with standard DRAM, its expansion could further constrain standard‑DRAM supply.

Against this backdrop, Micron’s 512GB DDR5 RDIMM offers more than just a larger per‑module capacity; it provides higher density and lower power per gigabyte to support AI and data‑intensive servers. As volume production approaches in 2027, the adoption of such ultra‑high‑capacity server memory will be a key indicator of how data centers can alleviate memory bottlenecks and energy costs.

items.title: 華為獲高通付費取得專利 邏輯折疊技術成AI晶片突圍新武器
items.title_en: Huawei Secures Paid Patent Deal with Qualcomm; Logic Folding Technology Becomes New AI Chip Breakthrough Weapon
paras: 華為10月5日宣布與美國晶片巨頭高通(QCOM-US)達成一項為期多年的廣泛專利許可協議，涵蓋雙方在5G、運算、人工智慧和網路等多個技術領域的專利組合交叉許可，同時高通將收購華為在美國的部分運算、人工智慧、網路及其他技術領域的專利。
令人有些意外的是，根據《彭博社》等外媒披露，這不僅是華為與高通達成的首份涵蓋5G技術的專利許可協議，同時根據雙方協議，高通還將首次向華為付費以取得其專利，尤其是華為邏輯折疊（LogicFolding）晶片技術背後的專利。
「邏輯折疊」以及韜定律，是華為在晶片突圍中找到的另一條道路。它提出以「時間（τ）縮微」替代「幾何縮微」，作為半導體與電子系統演進的新指導原則，不再執著於把電晶體做得更小，而是通過「邏輯折疊」等創新技術，持續壓縮信號在系統中的傳播時延，同時不斷提升電晶體的有效密度，從而維持半導體與電子系統的持續演進。
《彭博社》在報導中指出，邏輯折疊能幫助華為縮小與台積電等行業領導者之間的差距，該方案著重於提升資料傳輸速度，以彌補中國無法獲得ASML極紫外光刻機的不足。
剛剛搭載於華為Mate90 Pro Max手機上的麒麟9050 Pro，是全球首款採用邏輯折疊技術的「韜定律」SoC晶片。
據華為常務董事、產品投資評審委員會主任余承東介紹，麒麟9050 Pro搭載的靈犀CPU採用9核16線程，多核性能提升超23%；馬良GPU渲染性能提升40%以上；達芬奇架構的NPU性能提升140%；第10代ISP處理拍照和影片的能力大幅提升；巴龍基帶提供可提供超越5.5G的通信性能。
余承東在發布會上說道，「邏輯折疊三維架構突破了尺寸限制，高密度垂直互聯通道，讓信號直連直達。信號傳輸的鍵合數量高達500萬。信號傳輸間隔數量是500萬，但是它的連接數超過5000萬。這種傳輸的頻寬高達125TB每秒。我們將傳輸時間微縮，性能大幅提升，關鍵路徑時延下降30%以上。」
關注華為的媒體指出，華為確實在半導體設計技術領域開闢了一條新的道路。隨著華為在晶片製造領域的進步，高通現在正努力取得這家中國公司在3D晶片堆疊方面不斷增長的專利組合。此舉最終將有助於華為拓展其在海外市場的AI業務。
事實上，《觀察者網》此前也曾報導過，韜定律並不是華為自己的獨角戲。推進韜定律的持續演進和落地，這條路上還有非常多的挑戰。華為半導體業務負責人何庭波也在論文中寫道，「大量開放問題，無單一組織可獨立解決——工具鏈、標準、基準、器件物理、經濟模型均需跨界協作。本文既是一線實踐報告，也是產業邀請。」
從這個角度來看，華為向高通授權邏輯折疊專利也具合理性。外媒稱，與高通達成的這項新的多年交叉許可專利協議對華為來說無疑是一項重大勝利，因為華為一直在尋求在全球範圍內拓展其人工智慧和5G技術解決方案。
根據《彭博社》報導，華為與高通此次達成的協議，還包括近封裝和共封裝光器件及網路相關的技術。而觀察者網在近期的華為全聯接大會2026上獲悉，華為研發了新一代NPO（近封裝光學）光互聯產品Hi-ONE，即將規模量產。這是業界首個量產的NPO產品，是行業目前最大傳輸能力的NPO產品，總容量達到7.2T，也是唯一實現內置光源的NPO產品。
此次達成協議，是第一份華為與高通簽訂的5G專利許可協議，也是歷年來第一份與高通簽訂的收入轉正協議。華為表示，公司目前已與美國、歐洲、日韓等主要ICT廠家簽署了270餘份專利許可協議。此次簽約後，華為獲取的專利許可協議總額超過69億美元。
華為於2001年首次向高通支付專利許可費，並於2011年首次從摩托羅拉獲得專利許可收入。此次與高通達成協議之前，華為曾於今年8月宣布與惠普公司達成一項專利許可協議。自2021年以來，華為知識產權許可業務已實現正向收入。
paras_en: On October 5, Huawei announced that it has reached a multi‑year, broad patent‑licensing agreement with U.S. chip giant Qualcomm (QCOM‑US). The deal covers cross‑licensing of patent portfolios in multiple technology areas, including 5G, computing, artificial intelligence and networking, and Qualcomm will acquire a portion of Huawei’s U.S. patents in computing, AI, networking and other fields.

Surprisingly, according to Bloomberg and other foreign media, this is not only the first Huawei‑Qualcomm patent‑licensing agreement that includes 5G technology, but under the deal Qualcomm will also pay Huawei for the first time to obtain its patents, notably those behind Huawei’s LogicFolding chip technology.

Logic Folding and the so‑called “Tao Law” represent another path Huawei has found to break through in chips. It proposes using “time (τ) miniaturization” instead of “geometric miniaturization” as a new guiding principle for semiconductor and electronic‑system evolution, shifting focus from making transistors smaller to compressing signal propagation delay through innovations such as Logic Folding while continuously increasing the effective density of transistors, thereby sustaining semiconductor and system progress.

Bloomberg reported that Logic Folding can help Huawei narrow the gap with industry leaders such as TSMC. The approach emphasizes boosting data‑transfer speed to compensate for China’s inability to obtain ASML’s extreme‑ultraviolet lithography machines.
The Kirin 9050 Pro, just launched in the Huawei Mate 90 Pro Max smartphone, is the world’s first “Tao Law” SoC that employs Logic Folding technology.

According to Huawei Executive Director and Head of the Product Investment Review Committee Yu Chengdong, the Kirin 9050 Pro’s Lingxi CPU uses a 9‑core, 16‑thread design delivering more than a 23% uplift in multi‑core performance; the Malian GPU achieves over 40% higher rendering performance; the Da Vinci‑based NPU sees a 140% performance boost; the 10th‑generation ISP dramatically improves photo and video processing; and the Balong modem provides communication capabilities beyond 5.5G.

Yu said at the launch event, “The three‑dimensional Logic Folding architecture breaks size limits with high‑density vertical interconnect channels that let signals go straight through. The number of bonded signal paths reaches 5 million, the total connections exceed 50 million, and the transmission bandwidth hits 125 TB per second. By shrinking transmission time, performance jumps, and critical‑path latency drops by more than 30%.”

Media following Huawei note that the company has indeed forged a new route in semiconductor design. As Huawei advances in chip manufacturing, Qualcomm is now working to acquire the growing portfolio of Huawei’s 3D‑stacking patents, a move that should ultimately help Huawei expand its AI business overseas.

In fact, Observer.com previously reported that the Tao Law is not Huawei’s solo act. Advancing its evolution and implementation faces many challenges; Huawei’s semiconductor head He Tingbo wrote in a paper that “numerous open problems cannot be solved by a single organization—toolchains, standards, benchmarks, device physics, and economic models all require cross‑industry collaboration. This paper is both a frontline practice report and an industry invitation.”

From this perspective, Huawei’s licensing of Logic Folding patents to Qualcomm makes sense. Foreign media say the new multi‑year cross‑licensing pact is a major win for Huawei, which has been seeking to broaden its AI and 5G solutions worldwide.

Bloomberg notes that the agreement also covers near‑package and co‑package optical devices and networking technologies. At Huawei’s Full‑Connection Conference 2026, Observer.com learned that Huawei has developed a next‑generation NPO (Near‑Package Optics) interconnect product, Hi‑ONE, which is about to enter mass production. It is the industry’s first mass‑produced NPO product, offering the highest current transmission capacity of 7.2 Tb and the only NPO with an integrated light source.

The deal marks the first 5G patent‑licensing agreement Huawei has signed with Qualcomm and the first revenue‑recognition agreement of its kind. Huawei said it has now signed more than 270 patent‑licensing agreements with major ICT firms in the U.S., Europe, Japan, South Korea and elsewhere, and the total value of the agreements it has obtained now exceeds $6.9 billion.

Huawei first paid a patent‑licensing fee to Qualcomm in 2001 and received its first patent‑licensing revenue from Motorola in 2011. Earlier this year, in August, Huawei announced a patent‑licensing deal with HP. Since 2021, Huawei’s IP‑licensing business has generated positive revenue.

items.title: 3100→3300！高盛調高台積電目標價6.5%  看好AI帶動業績強勁成長
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Raises TSMC Target Price to NT$3,300, Up 6.5% – Bullish on AI‑Driven Strong Earnings Growth
paras: 華爾街投行高盛因AI需求在GPU、網路晶片與伺服器CPU三大領域同步擴張，重申台積電「買進」投資評等，目標價由3100元新台幣調升至3300元，並大幅上修2027、2028年資本支出預測，反映先進製程與先進封裝產能瓶頸持續緊繃。
高盛分析師Evelyn Yu表示，由Agentic AI驅動的更強CPU需求，是過去一年的關鍵變化。相較於單純大模型訓練，AI智慧體應用需多步推理、工具呼叫、任務編排與多模型協作，除推高GPU與ASIC加速器和高速互連晶片用量，也增加伺服器CPU在排程、預處理與系統管理上的負載；網路晶片則受惠於資料中心scale‑up、scale‑out頻寬升級。
Yu還指出，台積電在先進邏輯製程、小晶片設計平台與CoWoS等先進封裝的完整覆蓋，使其同時受惠於加速器、CPU與交換器訂單。
財測方面，高盛預估台積電2026、2027年美元營收分別年增42%、36.9%，毛利率約67.2%、67.5%，獲利高成長主因高階AI晶片佔比提升、N3與後續N2製程良率改善，以及先進封裝溢價。
資本支出方面，高盛預估將原先預測的2027年780億美元、2028年820億美元，分別上調至850億、980億美元，用於支援長期客戶承諾，擴充先進晶圓、CoWoS產能與相關供應鏈。
高盛認為，AI資本支出循環從「訓練主導」轉向「訓練＋推理＋智慧體」並行，單一雲端客戶與主權AI、企業級推論同時放量，台積電議價能力與產能利用率可望維持高檔。3300元目標價相當於在既有利潤率與成長假設下，給予先進節點龍頭更高溢價。
但高盛也點出潛在風險指出，若超大規模雲端資本開支放緩、CoWoS擴產不及導致出貨延後，或美國出口管制、海外廠區成本與電力供給干擾，可能影響毛利率與資本報酬。整體而言，高盛上修劇本核心在「AI不只買GPU」，網路與CPU需求接力，使台積電先進製程與封裝的成長周期再延長。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs, the Wall Street investment bank, reiterated a "Buy" rating on TSMC as AI demand expands simultaneously across GPUs, network chips, and server CPUs. It raised the target price from NT$3,100 to NT$3,300 and sharply increased its 2027‑2028 capital‑expenditure forecasts, reflecting continued bottlenecks in advanced process and advanced packaging capacity.

Analyst Evelyn Yu said that stronger CPU demand driven by agentic AI was the key change over the past year. Compared with pure large‑model training, AI‑agent applications require multi‑step reasoning, tool calls, task orchestration and multi‑model collaboration, which not only push up usage of GPUs, ASIC accelerators and high‑speed interconnect chips, but also increase server‑CPU load for scheduling, preprocessing and system management; network chips benefit from data‑center scale‑up and scale‑out bandwidth upgrades.

Yu also noted that TSMC’s full coverage of advanced logic processes, small‑chip design platforms and CoWoS advanced packaging allows it to benefit simultaneously from accelerator, CPU and switch orders.

In its financial outlook, Goldman forecasts TSMC’s 2026 and 2027 dollar revenues to grow 42% and 36.9% year‑over‑year, with gross margins of roughly 67.2% and 67.5%. The high profit growth is driven by a larger share of high‑end AI chips, yield improvements in N3 and subsequent N2 processes, and premium pricing for advanced packaging.

Regarding capital spending, Goldman lifts its original forecasts for 2027 from $78 billion to $85 billion and for 2028 from $82 billion to $98 billion, to support long‑term customer commitments and expand advanced wafer, CoWoS capacity and related supply chains.

Goldman believes the AI capital‑expenditure cycle is shifting from a "training‑led" model to a parallel "training + inference + agent" approach. With both single‑cloud customers and sovereign AI as well as enterprise‑level inference scaling up, TSMC’s pricing power and capacity utilization are expected to stay high. The NT$3,300 target price reflects a higher premium for the advanced‑node leader under existing margin and growth assumptions.

However, Goldman also flags potential risks: a slowdown in ultra‑large‑scale cloud capex, slower‑than‑expected CoWoS expansion causing shipment delays, or U.S. export controls, overseas plant costs and power‑supply disruptions could hurt margins and return on capital. Overall, Goldman’s upgraded scenario hinges on the core premise that "AI doesn’t just buy GPUs"—network and CPU demand follow, extending the growth cycle for TSMC’s advanced processes and packaging.

items.title: 高盛上調台積電目標價至3300元 看好AI需求續強
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Raises TSMC Target Price to NT$3,300, Bullish on Continued AI Demand
paras: 高盛看好AI需求持續擴張，將台積電(2330-TW) 目標價由新台幣3,100元上調至3,300元，維持「買進」評級，並調高資本支出預估。
高盛分析師Evelyn Yu指出，AI需求持續擴及GPU、網路晶片與伺服器CPU，其中代理型AI帶動CPU需求增強，是過去一年來的關鍵變化。
高盛預估，以美元計算，台積電2026年及2027年營收將分別年增42%與36.9%，毛利率則達67.2%與67.5%。隨著AI需求擴張，高盛也將台積電2027年及2028年資本支出預估，由780億及820億美元，均上調至850億美元。
台積電與馬斯克旗下Terafab晶片製造計畫洽談合作，消息激勵台積電台股及美股ADR股價(TSM-US) 雙雙衝高。馬斯克已證實雙方正在討論，但合作尚未定案；分析師認為，台積電與英特爾 (INTC-US) 可能分別承接這項大型計畫的部分工作。
馬斯克上週六 (3日) 在社群平台 X 回應台積電參與 Terafab 的消息時表示：「目前只是討論，但可能會有進展。」另一則貼文形容 Terafab 規模將極為龐大，台積電提供的任何產能都將屬於補充，馬斯克也回覆認同。
瑞穗證券交易部分析師 Jordan Klein 認為，台積電在大規模先進製程晶片製造領域具領先地位，與 Terafab 合作具有合理性。他推測，台積電評估在德州設立新製造基地的消息，可能與這項計畫有關，馬斯克旗下企業則可能成為主要客戶。
台積電預計週四(8日)公布的 9 月營收，將是市場接下來觀察營運動能的重要指標。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs is optimistic about the ongoing expansion of AI demand and has raised its target price for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330‑TW) from NT$3,100 to NT$3,300, maintaining a “Buy” rating and increasing its capital‑expenditure forecast.

Analyst Evelyn Yu of Goldman Sachs noted that AI demand continues to spread across GPUs, networking chips and server CPUs, with generative AI driving stronger CPU demand—a key shift over the past year.

Goldman estimates that, in US‑dollar terms, TSMC’s revenue will grow 42% in 2026 and 36.9% in 2027, with gross margins of 67.2% and 67.5% respectively. As AI demand expands, the firm also lifted its 2027 and 2028 capital‑expenditure estimates from $78 billion and $82 billion to $85 billion each.

TSMC is in talks with Elon Musk’s Terafab chip‑manufacturing project, a development that pushed both TSMC’s Taiwan‑listed shares and its US ADR (TSM‑US) higher. Musk has confirmed the discussions are ongoing, though no deal is final; analysts think TSMC and Intel (INTC‑US) could each take on parts of the large‑scale project.

When Musk responded on X last Saturday (the 3rd) to news of TSMC’s involvement in Terafab, he wrote: “It’s just discussions at this point, but there could be progress.” In another post he described Terafab’s scale as massive, saying any capacity TSMC provides would be supplemental, a sentiment Musk agreed with.

Jordan Klein, an analyst in the trading division of Mizuho Securities, said TSMC’s leading position in large‑scale advanced‑process chip manufacturing makes a Terafab partnership logical. He speculated that TSMC’s rumored plan to set up a new fab in Texas may be tied to the project, with Musk’s companies likely to become a major customer.
TSMC expects to release its September revenue on Thursday (the 8th), which will be a key gauge for the market’s view of the company’s operational momentum going forward.

items.title: 中東金主來了？阿聯投資團傳出資100億美元 助OpenAI估值衝1.4兆
items.title_en: Middle East Money Arrives? UAE Investment Group Rumored to Contribute $10 Billion to Boost OpenAI Valuation to $1.4 Trillion
paras: 數名知情人士透露，OpenAI正與包括阿布達比投資公司MGX在內的多家阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)投資基金洽談，希望他們協助支持ChatGPT開發商這一輪300億美元的融資。
其中一人表示，這些基金將組成聯合投資團，參與這輪融資。另有知情人士透露，阿聯基金合計討論投入的資金上看100億美元。
知情人士表示，貝萊德(BlackRock)也正與這個投資團洽談，希望參與這輪融資。OpenAI與貝萊德拒絕置評。MGX代表在正常辦公時間以外未回應置評請求。
OpenAI據傳正尋求至少300億美元的資金，估值約1.4兆美元。該公司已將首次公開發行(IPO)的計畫延至至少明年，理由是目前正專注於人工智慧(AI)安全工作。知情人士表示，OpenAI目前尚未敲定主導投資人，但與典型的創投融資不同，這次向投資人提出1.4兆美元的融資前估值(pre-money valuation)作為固定價格。通常在這種情況下，投資公司會先針對融資輪提出條件，再進行協商。
OpenAI最近一次募資在3月完成，共取得1220億美元，當時包括這筆新資金在內的公司估值達8520億美元。
包括OpenAI與Anthropic在內的頂尖AI公司，過去都曾尋求資金雄厚的中東投資人支持，以滿足開發及支援先進AI軟體所需要的大量資本。
MGX先前已參與OpenAI及Anthropic的融資。彭博新聞報導，這家投資公司今年稍早募集將近500億美元，以加速在AI基建與技術方面的投資。
知情人士表示，OpenAI也已和現有投資人加州大學(University of California)的捐贈基金洽談，希望其參與這輪融資。知情人士說，現有支持者Thrive Capital與Andreessen Horowitz也已討論投入資金。
paras_en: Several insiders say OpenAI is in talks with multiple United Arab Emirates (UAE) investment funds, including Abu Dhabi’s MGX, to seek their support for a $30 billion financing round for the ChatGPT developer.

One source said the funds would form a joint investment consortium to participate in the round, and another insider indicated that the UAE funds are discussing a combined commitment of up to $10 billion.

Sources added that BlackRock is also negotiating with the consortium to join the financing. OpenAI and BlackRock declined to comment, and MGX did not respond to comment requests outside normal business hours.

OpenAI is reportedly seeking at least $30 billion, valuing the company at roughly $1.4 trillion. The firm has pushed back its IPO plans to at least next year to focus on AI safety. Insiders said OpenAI has not yet nailed down a lead investor, but unlike typical venture rounds, this round is being pitched with a fixed pre‑money valuation of $1.4 trillion, after which investors will negotiate terms.
OpenAI’s most recent fundraising closed in March, raising $122 billion and bringing the company’s valuation, including the new capital, to $852 billion.
Top AI firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic have historically courted deep‑pocketed Middle‑East investors to fund the massive capital needs of developing and supporting advanced AI software.

MGX previously participated in financing for OpenAI and Anthropic. Bloomberg reported the firm raised nearly $50 billion earlier this year to accelerate investments in AI infrastructure and technology.

Sources said OpenAI is also in talks with its existing investor, the University of California’s endowment fund, to join the round, and that current backers Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz have also discussed contributing.

items.title: 市值有望本月破6兆美元！輝達連三天收盤創歷史新高　分析師：仍有續漲理由
items.title_en: Market Cap Could Surpass $6 Trillion This Month! Nvidia Closes at Record Highs for Three Consecutive Days — Analyst: Still Reasons for Further Gains
paras: AI晶片巨擘輝達股價周一(5日)再刷新歷史紀錄，收盤報每股238.9美元，單日上漲2.12%，連續第三個交易日以收盤價創歷史新高，且盤後進一步上漲至239.54 美元，以周一收盤價計算，輝達市值約5.76 兆美元，繼續穩居全球市值最高上市公司。
隨著輝達股價在四個月內首次創下新高，分析師對未來感到樂觀。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson表示，隨著輝達越來越接近實現未來財務預期，「市場越來越難以忽視」輝達的成長前景與估值之間的脫節。
Bryson預估，輝達將以70%的速度成長，但當前股價不到下一個財年的EPS的20倍，顯得相對便宜。
法巴銀行分析師Karl Ackerman上周也在最新研究報告中寫道：「儘管面臨來自同行甚至自身客戶的競爭，輝達仍然是AI基礎設施的基石。」他將輝達目標價上調至每股345美元，相較於周一收盤價，這意味著45%的上漲空間。
另據選擇權市場價格分析，輝達本月底前市值達6兆美元的機率約50%，12月18日前則約67%
輝達上周一(9月28日)宣布實施1500億美元規模的庫藏股，加上美國總統川普與AI企業高層會面，成為股價上漲動能。
paras_en: Nvidia’s stock price set another historic record on Monday (the 5th), closing at $238.90 per share, up 2.12% on the day and marking the third consecutive trading day that the closing price hit a new all‑time high; after hours trading pushed the price to $239.54. Based on Monday’s close, Nvidia’s market value is about $5.76 trillion, keeping it firmly as the world’s most valuable listed company.
With Nvidia’s share price reaching a fresh high for the first time in four months, analysts are feeling optimistic about the outlook.

Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson said that as Nvidia gets ever closer to meeting its future financial targets, “the market finds it increasingly hard to ignore” the disconnect between Nvidia’s growth prospects and its valuation.
Bryson projects Nvidia will grow at a 70% rate, yet the current share price is less than 20 times next‑year earnings per share, making it relatively cheap.

Bank of America analyst Karl Ackerman wrote in a recent research note that “despite competition from peers and even some of its own customers, Nvidia remains the cornerstone of AI infrastructure.” He raised Nvidia’s target price to $345 per share, which implies about a 45% upside from Monday’s close.
Option‑market pricing analysis suggests there is roughly a 50% chance Nvidia’s market cap will reach $6 trillion by the end of this month, and about a 67% chance it will do so by December 18.
Nvidia announced on Monday, September 28, a $150 billion share‑repurchase program, and the meeting between U.S. President Trump and AI‑industry executives added further momentum to the stock’s rise.

items.title: 美股內部裂痕擴大 看似危險其實有機會！標普500 年末可能強勢上漲
items.title_en: U.S. Stock Market Rift Deepens: Seemingly Dangerous Yet Full of Opportunity! S&P 500 Could Surge Strongly by Year‑End
paras: 商業週刊《巴隆》報導指出，美股大盤表面仍維持強勢，但市場內部已出現明顯分化，部分分析師認為，這種極端的市場廣度背離未必代表行情即將崩跌，反而可能為年末反彈埋下伏筆。
標普500指數9月收盤僅下跌0.5%, 距離8月創下的歷史高點不到1%。在聯準會升息、10年期美債殖利率升至2002年以來最高水準, 加上伊朗戰事持續推升能源價格的背景下, 美股仍能維持高檔表現, 顯示大型科技股與AI相關股票的支撐力道相當強勁。
不過, 若進一步觀察市場內部, 情況則明顯不同。以市值加權計算的標普500指數9月僅跌0.5%, 但等權重標普500指數同期下跌約5%, 並連續第7週走低。過去出現類似連續下跌情況的年份僅有2002年及2022年。
BTIG首席市場技術分析師喬納森．克林斯基指出, 當標普500距離歷史高點不到2%, 但成分股中創52週新低的股票數量卻超過創52週新高的股票, 這種現象自2000年以來從未出現。這也使市場內部疲弱程度更加受到關注。
9月標普500的11大產業板塊中, 僅資訊科技及通訊服務兩大板塊上漲。費城半導體指數9月大漲9.5%, Roundhill「美股七巨頭」ETF則上漲4.3%, 顯示市場漲勢高度集中在大型科技及AI相關股票。
其中, Meta Platforms(META-US)成為市場焦點。受旗下「Muse」AI智能體相關題材帶動, Meta股價9月大漲27%, 單一股票就為標普500指數當月漲幅貢獻約0.6個百分點。
輝達(NVDA-US)今年以來股價上漲約24%, 但本益比已降至低於大盤整體水準。Meta同樣出現估值下降現象, 即使9月股價大幅上漲, 目前估值仍低於年初水準。
這一點與2000年前後的網路泡沫存在明顯差異。當年微軟(MSFT-US)、思科(CSCO-US)等大型科技股估值快速膨脹, 而目前大型AI相關企業雖然成為市場主要推動力量, 但部分龍頭公司的估值並未同步升至歷史泡沫水準。
目前市場分化的核心邏輯, 更接近投資人重新評估AI時代的贏家與輸家。Meta股價上漲之際, Planet Fitness及紐約時報等企業股價卻受到壓力, 原因在於市場擔心AI智能體可能協助消費者取消不再使用的訂閱服務。
金融業同樣受到AI題材影響。嘉信理財及美國銀行股價承壓, 市場擔憂AI工具可能改變投資人管理資金的方式, 進而減少放在低收益帳戶中的資金。
能源及航空業也出現截然不同的走勢。柴油價格飆升帶動瓦萊羅能源(VLO-US)及Phillips 66(PSX-US)股價創下歷史新高, 但捷藍航空及美國航空集團(AAL-US)等航空業者則受到能源成本攀升打擊。
高利率環境同樣加劇企業之間的差異。負擔大量浮動利率債務的公司, 或主要現金流需要多年後才能實現的企業, 在融資成本上升時承受更大壓力。
卡里克．萊恩公司的約翰．馬歇爾表示, 當前市場真正的主線可能是幾乎所有熱門趨勢都同時存在贏家與輸家, 投資人正透過股價重新分配資金。
因此, 單純從市場廣度惡化判斷美股即將崩跌, 未必完全合理。阿卡迪安資產管理投資組合經理人兼研究員歐文．拉蒙特認為, 市場集中度高並不代表風險一定更大。如果將目前的「七巨頭」拆分成49家公司, 市場集中度看似降低, 但投資風險並不會因此自然下降。
歷史資料也顯示, 市場廣度疲弱並不一定是可靠的短期看空訊號。貝斯波克投資集團指出, 市場上漲時, 廣泛參與當然更健康, 但窄幅上漲能否延續, 最終仍取決於帶動行情的少數股票自身能否維持強勢。
此外, 標普500本身具備持續汰弱留強的機制。1957年最初納入標普500指數的500家公司中, 目前僅約50家公司仍留在指數內。隨著企業經營狀況改變, 表現不佳的公司會被剔除, 新的成長型企業則會被納入, 因此指數本身並非一成不變。
摩根士丹利首席美國股票策略師邁克．威爾遜認為, 指數與市場廣度之間的背離最終仍會修正。他預期, 最可能的情況是未來幾週大盤可能先走弱, 但如果美債市場波動率下降, 市場廣度可能重新追上指數, 推動美股短期進一步上漲。
如果債市波動持續, 威爾遜則認為指數與個股可能在未來一個月逐步尋找平衡, 隨後市場有機會在年底出現較強勁的行情。
油價及美債殖利率走勢將是重要催化因素。KKM Financial執行長傑夫．基爾伯格認為, 伊朗問題最終可能獲得解決, 如果能源市場風險下降, 原油價格可能大幅回落, 同時推動利率下行。他預期10年期美債殖利率有機會重新跌破5%。
第三季財報季也將成為市場下一個重要考驗。FactSet數據顯示, 分析師平均預期標普500成分股第三季獲利將年增29%, 若預測成真, 將是連續第3季錄得約25%的獲利成長。
基爾伯格認為, 如果油價及利率同步回落, 同時企業財報持續維持超過25%的獲利成長, 將可能成為推動標普500指數升至8000點的重要催化因素。8000點較當時周四收盤水準高約4.4%。
美國中期選舉也可能成為另一項市場催化因素。摩根大通全球市場策略主管杜布拉夫科．拉科斯－布哈斯指出, 歷史上美股波動率往往會在中期選舉前數個月升高, 因此目前偏低的VIX恐慌指數仍可能進一步上升。
不過, 他認為11月3日中期選舉結束後, 政治不確定性有望降低, 市場也可能出現一次「出清」。歷史經驗顯示, 中期選舉結束後數個月, 美股表現大多偏正面。
目前投資人最大的期待, 是推動宏觀不確定性的幾項因素逐步退潮, 包括伊朗戰事、油價、利率及債市波動, 同時企業獲利繼續維持強勁成長。
雖然這項情境仍存在風險, 但今年美股整體估值已明顯下修, 而且在過去8週市場反覆震盪期間持續下降。這意味著投資人並非完全忽視利率上升與企業成本壓力, 市場內部疲弱本身也反映出資金正在重新配置。
高盛數據顯示, 美國股市整體投資情緒已明顯轉弱至負面區間, 水準與3月相近。若AI投資與企業獲利仍能維持目前的強度, 同時油價與利率壓力逐步下降, 美股仍可能在2026年最後幾個月迎來強勁反攻。
換言之, 當前美股最大的風險並非單純的大盤估值過高, 而是市場漲勢過度集中於少數大型科技股。但這種分化也可能成為行情重新洗牌的前兆。只要AI投資熱潮沒有失速、企業獲利沒有大幅低於預期, 即使不是所有股票都參與上漲, 標普500仍可能在年末走出一波強勢行情。
paras_en: Business Weekly’s “Baron” reports that while the U.S. market appears strong on the surface, internal divergence is becoming evident. Some analysts say this extreme breadth deviation does not necessarily signal an imminent crash, but may instead set the stage for a year‑end rebound.

The S&P 500 closed September down only 0.5%, less than 1% away from the August all‑time high. Despite the Fed’s rate hikes, 10‑year Treasury yields at their highest since 2002, and ongoing Iran conflict pushing energy prices higher, U.S. equities have held near‑top levels, showing strong support from large‑cap tech and AI‑related stocks.

However, a closer look inside the market tells a different story. The market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500 fell just 0.5% in September, while the equal‑weight S&P 500 dropped about 5% over the same period and has been declining for seven straight weeks. Only 2002 and 2022 have seen similar consecutive declines.

BTIG chief market technologist Jonathan Klinisky notes that when the S&P 500 is less than 2% from its record high but the number of constituents hitting 52‑week lows exceeds those hitting 52‑week highs, this phenomenon has not occurred since 2000, highlighting growing internal weakness.

Among the S&P 500’s 11 sector groups in September, only Information Technology and Communication Services posted gains. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 9.5% and the Roundhill “U.S. Seven Giants” ETF rose 4.3%, indicating that the rally is heavily concentrated in large‑cap tech and AI stocks.

Meta Platforms (META‑US) became the market’s focus. Driven by its “Muse” AI agent theme, Meta’s stock surged 27% in September, contributing roughly 0.6 percentage points to the S&P 500’s monthly gain.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is up about 24% year‑to‑date, but its P/E has fallen below the broader market average. Meta shows a similar valuation decline; despite its September price surge, its valuation remains below early‑year levels.

This contrasts sharply with the early‑2000s internet bubble, when giants like Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Cisco (CSCO‑US) saw valuations balloon rapidly. Today, while large AI firms drive the market, many leading players have not seen valuations climb to bubble‑era heights.

The core logic of today’s market split is investors reassessing winners and losers in the AI era. As Meta rallies, stocks such as Planet Fitness and The New York Times face pressure because the market fears AI agents could help consumers cancel unused subscriptions.

Financials are also feeling AI‑related pressure. Charles Schwab and Bank of America shares are under pressure as investors worry AI tools could change how investors manage money, potentially pulling funds out of low‑yield accounts.

Energy and airlines are moving in opposite directions. Diesel price spikes have lifted Valero Energy (VLO‑US) and Phillips 66 (PSX‑US) to record highs, while airlines like JetBlue and American Airlines (AAL‑US) are hit by rising fuel costs.

A high‑interest‑rate environment further widens corporate disparities. Companies burdened with large floating‑rate debt or whose cash flows lie many years ahead feel greater strain as financing costs rise.
John Marshall of Carrick Lane says the market’s true storyline now is that almost every hot trend has both winners and losers, and investors are reallocating capital through stock price movements.

Thus, judging an imminent crash solely from worsening market breadth may be unreasonable. Irving Lamont, portfolio manager and researcher at Arcadian Asset Management, argues that high concentration does not automatically mean higher risk. Splitting today’s “seven giants” into 49 companies would lower apparent concentration, but risk would not necessarily drop.

Historical data also show that weak breadth is not a reliable short‑term bearish signal. Basspoke Investment Group notes that broad participation is healthier in a rally, yet whether a narrow‑based rise can continue ultimately depends on whether the few leading stocks can stay strong.

Moreover, the S&P 500 has an inherent “survivor‑bias” mechanism. Of the original 500 companies added in 1957, only about 50 remain today. Poor performers are removed and fast‑growing firms added, so the index is not static.

Morgan Stanley U.S. equity strategist Mike Wilson believes the divergence between the index and market breadth will eventually correct. He expects the broad market may weaken in the coming weeks, but if Treasury volatility eases, breadth could catch up, pushing U.S. stocks higher in the short term.
If bond‑market volatility persists, Wilson sees the index and individual stocks finding balance over the next month, after which the market could deliver a stronger year‑end rally.

Oil prices and Treasury yields will be key catalysts. Jeff Kilberg, CEO of KKM Financial, says a resolution to the Iran issue could lower energy‑market risk, pulling oil sharply lower and driving rates down. He expects the 10‑year Treasury yield could slip back below 5%.

The third‑quarter earnings season will be another crucial test. FactSet data show analysts expect S&P 500 constituents to post a 29% YoY earnings increase in Q3; if realized, that would mark the third consecutive quarter of roughly 25% profit growth.

Kilberg adds that if oil and rates both retreat while corporate earnings keep exceeding 25% growth, it could be a major catalyst to lift the S&P 500 toward 8,000 points—about 4.4% above the Thursday closing level at the time.

The U.S. midterm elections could also act as a market catalyst. JPMorgan global markets strategist Dubravko Lakos‑Buhas notes that historically volatility spikes in the months leading up to midterms, so the currently low VIX could still rise.

He expects that after the November 3 midterms, political uncertainty will ease and the market may experience a “clear‑out.” Historical patterns show that a few months post‑midterms, U.S. equities tend to perform positively.
Investors now most hope that the macro‑uncertainty drivers—Iran conflict, oil prices, rates, and bond‑market volatility—will gradually recede, while corporate profits continue strong growth.

Although risks remain, overall U.S. valuations have been markedly trimmed this year and have kept falling through the past eight weeks of choppy trading. This shows investors are not ignoring rate hikes and cost pressures; internal weakness also reflects capital reallocation.

Goldman data indicate overall U.S. market sentiment has shifted clearly into negative territory, similar to March levels. If AI investment and corporate earnings maintain current strength while oil and rate pressures ease, U.S. stocks could still mount a strong comeback in the final months of 2026.

In other words, the biggest risk to U.S. equities today is not an overvalued broad market but the extreme concentration of gains in a handful of large‑cap tech stocks. That split could signal a market reshuffle. As long as AI investment momentum holds and earnings stay above expectations, the S&P 500 can still deliver a robust year‑end rally even if not every stock participates.

items.title: 「麥加防務聯盟」決定啟動集體防御機制 在沙國部署兵力
items.title_en: Mecca Defense Alliance Decides to Activate Collective Defense Mechanism and Deploy Forces in Saudi Arabia
paras: 沙烏地阿拉伯、巴基斯坦和土耳其5日（周一）在利雅德舉行「麥加防務聯盟」戰略政治與防務委員會緊急會議，並發表聯合聲明，宣布啟動集體防禦機制，同意在沙國部署軍事力量。
聲明宣布，委員會決定立即推動落實集體防禦承諾，採取必要措施，向商定軍事力量和相關能力提供保障，確保其能夠按照已經批准的安排以及各成員國國內法律，在沙國境內迅速部署。
聲明稱，此舉旨在提升戰備、軍事一體化程度，以及三方共同應對和遏制威脅的能力。
聲明說，三方此次會議主要討論沙國面臨的安全形勢和威脅。作為「麥加防務聯盟」機制建設的一部分，委員會決定任命巴基斯坦退役中將努曼·馬哈茂德擔任聯盟首任秘書長，任期三年。
三方在聲明中強烈譴責針對麥加和麥地那的襲擊企圖，以及持續針對沙國平民、經濟設施的襲擊，並重申堅決反對任何針對沙國安全和領土完整的襲擊或威脅。
paras_en: On Monday, October 5, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey held an emergency meeting of the Mecca Defense Alliance Strategic Political and Defense Committee in Riyadh and issued a joint statement announcing the activation of the collective defense mechanism and agreeing to deploy military forces in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The statement announced that the committee has decided to immediately implement the collective defense commitment, taking necessary measures to guarantee the agreed‑upon military forces and related capabilities, ensuring they can be rapidly deployed within Saudi territory in accordance with the approved arrangements and the domestic laws of each member state.
The statement said the move is intended to enhance combat readiness, the degree of military integration, and the three parties’ joint ability to respond to and deter threats.

The statement noted that the meeting primarily discussed the security situation and threats facing Saudi Arabia. As part of building the Mecca Defense Alliance mechanism, the committee appointed retired Pakistani Lieutenant General Noman Mahmood as the alliance’s first secretary‑general for a three‑year term.

The three parties strongly condemned attempts to attack Mecca and Medina, as well as ongoing attacks on Saudi civilians and economic facilities, and reaffirmed their resolute opposition to any attacks or threats against Saudi security and territorial integrity.

items.title: 油價上漲、司機短缺 美國學生沒校車坐了
items.title_en: Oil Prices Rise, Driver Shortage Leaves US Students Without School Buses
paras: 對美國數百萬孩子而言，上學從一輛校車和手握方向盤的司機開始。如今，各學區卻難以同時承擔校車燃油與人力兩項開支。
據《Axios》5日（周一）報導，伊朗戰爭推高柴油價格，且美國各學區長期面臨校車司機短缺問題，雙重打擊下，學生錯過校內早餐、上課遲到、校園活動縮減。
美國全國學生交通協會的彼得·曼內拉表示：「對學區來說，交通開支屬於非教學類支出。」
他說：「學區的第一反應往往是，看看能從交通經費裡砍掉哪些項目，因為大家不想影響學校圖書館運作。」他說道，學區會優先保障教師、助教以及特殊教育的經費。
目前美國各學區正在合併校車線路、削減班次，想方設法提高車隊運行效率。
今年5月一份面向188名校方管理人員的調查顯示，40%學校調整了行車路線，25%學校縮短路線，20%減少可選擇線路，14%變更燃油採購方案，還有8%讓學生步行更遠路程才能到達站點。
曼內拉稱，上述調整會影響學生參與校園活動，或是讓學生的乘車點離家更遠，「這些舉措最終會影響孩子與家庭，這是誰都不願看到的局面」。
丹佛市郊櫻桃溪公立學區交通主管馬克·英格拉姆坦言，該學區校車司機缺口約40人。
他提到部分學生會因此錯過學校提供的早餐，或是第一節課遲到。
該學區共有約611台車，包含320輛黃色校車，另有專門接送特殊需求學生以及用於學區其他公務的車輛。
該學區今年燃油預算原本為150萬美元，增加30萬美元，但現在預估實際開支將達到200萬至230萬美元。英格拉姆表示，學區尚未削減服務，但正在厲行節約。
另據《Fox News》報導，馬里蘭州喬治王子縣公立學校承認，今年9月新學期開學以來，約有1萬名學生沒有分配到校車。
該學區官員稱，實際情況更嚴峻，另有至少2,000名學生僅能獲得單程校車服務，要嘛只有早班車，要嘛只有放學班車，無法兼顧往返。
全縣多地家長反映，孩子上學遲到、放學後數小時才能到家，或是完全沒有穩定通勤交通。作為應對，學區撤換了負責校車交通的主管，但情況依然未能好轉。
有家長表示，孩子每天要在車上耗上好幾個小時，「小孩早上7點上車，9點才能到校」，放學返程同樣路途漫長。
paras_en: For millions of American children, going to school starts with a school bus and a driver behind the wheel. Today, many districts are struggling to shoulder both fuel and labor costs for school buses.

Axios reported on Monday the 5th that the Iran war has pushed diesel prices higher, and U.S. districts have long faced a shortage of school‑bus drivers. The double hit is causing students to miss school‑breakfasts, arrive late to class, and see campus activities cut back.
Peter Manella of the National Student Transportation Association said, “For districts, transportation costs are a non‑instructional expense.”

He added, “The first reaction of a district is often to look at what can be trimmed from the transportation budget, because no one wants to affect the operation of the school library.” He said districts will prioritize funding for teachers, aides and special‑education programs.
Districts across the United States are merging bus routes, cutting trips and looking for ways to improve fleet efficiency.

A May survey of 188 school administrators found 40% of schools adjusted routes, 25% shortened routes, 20% reduced optional routes, 14% changed fuel‑procurement plans, and 8% forced students to walk farther to reach stops.

Manella said those adjustments affect student participation in school activities or push pick‑up points farther from home, “These measures ultimately impact children and families, a situation no one wants to see.”
Mark Ingram, the transportation director for Cherry Creek Public Schools in the Denver suburbs, admitted the district is short about 40 bus drivers.
He noted that some students are missing the school‑provided breakfast or arriving late to first period as a result.
The district operates roughly 611 vehicles, including 320 yellow school buses, plus vehicles dedicated to transporting special‑needs students and other district duties.

The district’s fuel budget was originally $1.5 million for the year, with a $300,000 increase, but actual spending is now projected at $2 million to $2.3 million. Ingram said the district has not cut services yet is tightening its belt.

Fox News reported that Prince George’s County Public Schools in Maryland acknowledged that since the start of the new school year in September, about 10,000 students have not been assigned a school bus.
District officials said the situation is even worse, with at least another 2,000 students receiving only one‑way bus service—either a morning or an afternoon bus—unable to cover both trips.

Parents across the county report children arriving late to school, not getting home until several hours after dismissal, or having no reliable commuting option at all. In response, the district replaced the official in charge of bus transportation, but conditions have not improved.
One parent said their child spends several hours on the bus each day, “The child gets on the bus at 7 a.m. and doesn’t arrive at school until 9 a.m.; the return trip is equally long.”

items.title: 美股重點新聞摘要2026年10月06日
paras:
今日操盤前瞻

items.title_en: Stocks and Currency Surge! Bolsonaro Leads Brazil Presidential Election, Stock Market Jumps 9% to Six‑Year High, Real Rises 5%, 3× Leveraged ETN Soars 37%
paras: 由於參議員波索納洛在巴西大選首輪投票中意外領先現任總統魯拉，巴西資產大漲，雷亞爾一度飆升5%，股市創六年來最大單日漲幅，三倍做多巴西ETN更大漲37%。
當地時間周日(4日)晚上，巴西總統大選首輪投票結果出爐，前總統之子、自由黨候選人弗拉維奧·波索納洛以約47%得票率意外領先現任總統魯拉以約45%位居第二，兩人將於10月25日進行第二輪角逐。
波索納洛比魯拉更親市場，首輪表現好於預期，帶動巴西股市、匯市全線大漲，巴西基準股指Bovespa一度大漲超9%，創2022年以來最大漲幅，巴西雷亞爾狂升值逾5%。
花旗建議投資人加碼巴西股票和本幣債券的看漲押注。該行策略師在最新研報中寫道：「波索納洛是對市場更友善的候選人，承諾實施財政緊縮、私有化、放鬆監管以及下調增值稅，其政黨在參議院的強勁表現應有助於推動其立法議程獲得通過。」
預測市場定價也顯示，預期波索納洛在10月25日決選中獲勝的機率很高，花旗建議買入巴西股票以及2031年到期的政府債券，即所謂的NTN-F。
paras_en: Because Senate candidate Jair Bolsonaro unexpectedly led incumbent President Lula in the first round of Brazil's presidential election, Brazilian assets rallied sharply, the real spiked up to 5% and the stock market posted its biggest single‑day gain in six years, while a 3× long Brazil ETN surged another 37%.

On Sunday night local time (the 4th), the first‑round results of Brazil's presidential election were released: former president’s son and Liberal Party candidate Flávio Bolsonaro captured about 47% of the vote, unexpectedly ahead of incumbent President Lula who came second with roughly 45%, and the two will face off in a runoff on October 25.

Bolsonaro is seen as more market‑friendly than Lula, and his better‑than‑expected first‑round performance drove a broad rally in Brazil’s equities and foreign‑exchange markets. The benchmark Bovespa index surged more than 9% at one point, the biggest jump since 2022, while the Brazilian real appreciated by over 5%.

Citigroup recommends investors increase exposure to Brazilian equities and local‑currency bonds. In its latest research note, the bank’s strategists wrote: “Bolsonaro is a candidate more favorable to markets, pledging fiscal tightening, privatizations, deregulation and a cut to the value‑added tax; his party’s strong showing in the Senate should help push his legislative agenda through.”

Market pricing forecasts also show a high probability that Bolsonaro will win the October 25 runoff. Citigroup advises buying Brazilian stocks and government bonds maturing in 2031, the so‑called NTN‑F.

paras: 美元周一(5日)小幅走高，主要受到歐元下跌的帶動。歐元一度跌至近17個月來最低水準，因市場對法國政府債務危機的擔憂升溫。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報102.14，創2025年4月9日以來最高。

歐洲外匯市場參與者正密切關注法國日益嚴重的財政衝擊。由於法國公共債務持續攀升，加上在明年總統大選前政治僵局嚴重，市場開始重新評估法國主權債券的風險溢價。
法國政府債券遭到猛烈拋售，兩年期公債殖利率單日大幅上升76個基點。同時，法國10年期 OAT國債與德國10年期Bund國債之間殖利率利差突破140個基點，創下2012年歐元區債務危機以來最大利差。
此外，法國5年期信用違約交換(CDS)價格飆升至87個基點，顯示外匯市場交易員正積極反映法國財政問題可能進一步蔓延至整個歐元區的風險。
法國上週公布了2027年度預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元(約605.9億美元)支出，將政府財政赤字控制在GDP的5%。然而，法國目前仍面臨嚴重財政問題。今年財政赤字預計將達GDP的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。
美債拋售仍推升美元
在美國方面，美國公債遭到大量拋售，導致殖利率大幅上升。
10年期美國公債殖利率上升2.9個基點，至5.309%，30年期公債殖利率則上升3個基點，至5.660%。兩者目前都徘徊在數十年來高點附近。
上周，對利率變化較敏感的短天期美債曾稍微獲得喘息，因美國經濟數據公布後，市場對聯準會(Fed)即將升息的預期有所下降。
聯準會偏好的通膨指標最新數據顯示，年增率有所放緩，同時，意外疲弱的非農就業報告也顯示美國勞動市場可能正在稍微降溫。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場預期本月底升息25個基點的機率，在上周結束時已降至約20%，而在該周初時還約為70%。
本周美國經濟數據相對清淡，市場主要關注聯準會上一次利率會議的會議紀要
周一，美國供應管理協會(ISM)公布9月服務業報告，顯示服務業經濟活動較8月放緩，但仍維持在代表擴張的區域。值得注意的是，服務業企業支付的價格指標在9月加速上升，創下2022年7月以來最高水準。
Lloyds Bank分析師表示，「本月初的數據相對清淡。這周主要焦點將是最終版的服務業與綜合PMI數據。這些數據應能提供更多歐元區經濟細節，並可能進一步說明能源價格上升所帶來的影響。此前公布的初步數據中，能源價格上漲的影響並不明顯。」

The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to €1 = $1.1222, briefly dropping to $1.1161, the lowest since May 16, 2025.

European FX market participants are closely watching France's worsening fiscal shock. With French public debt continuing to climb and a severe political deadlock ahead of next year’s presidential election, markets are reassessing the risk premium on French sovereign bonds.

French government bonds faced a sharp sell‑off, with the two‑year yield jumping 76 basis points in a single day. At the same time, the spread between France’s 10‑year OAT and Germany’s 10‑year Bund surged past 140 basis points, the widest gap since the euro‑area debt crisis of 2012.

Moreover, the price of France’s five‑year credit default swap spiked to 87 basis points, indicating that FX traders are actively pricing the risk that France’s fiscal problems could spread across the euro zone.

France unveiled its 2027 budget last week, aiming to cut €54 billion (about $60.59 billion) in spending and cap the fiscal deficit at 5% of GDP. However, France still faces serious fiscal challenges, with the current year’s deficit projected at 5.4% of GDP and public debt near 120% of GDP.
U.S. Treasury sell‑off continues to lift the dollar
In the United States, Treasury bonds have been sold off heavily, pushing yields sharply higher.
The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose 2.9 basis points to 5.309%, while the 30‑year yield climbed 3 basis points to 5.660%. Both are now hovering near multi‑decade highs.
Last week, short‑term Treasuries, which are more sensitive to rate changes, briefly caught a breather as market expectations for further Fed hikes eased after U.S. economic data releases.
The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge showed a slowdown in the annual growth rate, and a surprisingly weak jobs report suggested the U.S. labor market may be cooling slightly.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike by the end of the month fell to about 20% by the end of last week, down from roughly 70% at the start of the week.
U.S. economic data this week is relatively light, with the market mainly focused on the Fed’s minutes from the last rate‑setting meeting.

On Monday, the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its September services report, showing service‑sector activity slowing from August but still in expansion territory. Notably, the prices paid index accelerated in September, reaching its highest level since July 2022.

Lloyds Bank analyst said, “Data early this month have been relatively light. This week’s main focus will be the final services and composite PMI releases. Those numbers should provide more detail on the euro‑area economy and may further clarify the impact of rising energy prices. In the preliminary data released earlier, the effect of higher energy costs was not obvious.”

items.title: 美元快衝今年新高！策略師卻提醒別急著追
items.title_en: Dollar races to new high this year! Strategists warn not to chase it hastily
paras: 美元逼近今年最強水準，歐洲財政壓力與政治不確定性推升避險需求，但連續上漲也讓市場擔心漲勢過熱。本周美國經濟數據與聯準會(Fed)政策訊號，將成為美元能否續強的關鍵。
隨著歐元走弱，彭博美元現貨指數一度上漲0.4%，延續此前連續3周的漲勢。不過，部分技術指標顯示美元已進入超買區域，意味後續可能面臨回檔。
市場將密切關注ISM服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)、就業數據，以及周五公布的密西根大學消費者信心指數。Fed上月首次在3年來升息的會議紀錄與官員談話，也將影響市場對後續利率走向的判斷。
法國農業信貸銀行(Credit Agricole)(ACA-FR)G10外匯研究與策略主管Valentin Marinov表示，美元已超買且估值偏高，若本周美國數據不如預期，尤其促使投資人重新評估聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)鷹派共識的穩固程度，美元可能承壓。該行一項模型目前建議做多英鎊及瑞典克朗兌美元。
歐元疲弱與美國進一步升息預期，是近期美元走強的主要動力。但若市場開始質疑Fed政策路徑，或重新擔憂美國財政狀況，美元可能從高點回落。
分析師雖預期歐元仍有下跌空間，也指出近期賣壓主要來自歐洲債市緊張，若疑慮緩解，跌勢可能逆轉。相較瑞士法郎與挪威克朗，歐元兌美元跌幅仍較有限，顯示市場的看空押注並非只集中在歐元。
近期轉向看好美元的摩根士丹利(MS-US)也保持謹慎。David Adams領軍的外匯策略團隊警告，若不利美元的風險溢價突然升高，美元多頭部位可能觸發停損。因此，該行傾向等待回檔再買進，而非在目前價位追高。
paras_en: The dollar is nearing its strongest level of the year, as fiscal pressure in Europe and political uncertainty boost safe‑haven demand, but its continuous rise is causing the market to worry about an overheated rally. This week’s U.S. economic data and Federal Reserve policy signals will be key to whether the dollar can keep strengthening.

With the euro weakening, the Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index rose as much as 0.4%, extending a three‑week winning streak. However, some technical indicators show the dollar has entered overbought territory, suggesting a possible pull‑back ahead.

The market will watch the ISM Services PMI, employment figures, and Friday’s University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index closely. The Fed’s minutes from last month’s first rate‑hike meeting in three years, along with officials’ remarks, will also shape expectations for future rate moves.

Valentin Marinov, head of G10 FX research and strategy at Credit Agricole (ACA‑FR), said the dollar is overbought and overvalued; if this week’s U.S. data disappoint, especially if it leads investors to reassess the firmness of the FOMC’s hawkish consensus, the dollar could come under pressure. The bank’s model currently recommends going long the pound and the Swedish krona against the dollar.

The euro’s weakness and expectations of further U.S. rate hikes have been the main drivers of the dollar’s recent strength. But if the market begins to doubt the Fed’s policy path or revives concerns about U.S. fiscal conditions, the dollar could retreat from its highs.

Analysts, while still seeing downside potential for the euro, note that recent selling pressure stems mainly from tension in European bond markets; if those worries ease, the euro’s decline could reverse. Compared with the Swiss franc and Norwegian krone, the euro’s fall against the dollar remains relatively modest, showing bearish bets are not solely focused on the euro.

Morgan Stanley (MS‑US), which has recently turned more bullish on the dollar, remains cautious. Led by David Adams, the FX strategy team warns that a sudden spike in the risk premium against the dollar could trigger stop‑losses on long positions, so the firm prefers to wait for a pull‑back before buying rather than chasing higher prices now.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會10月不見得會再升息 股匯齊揚升值4.2分收31.788元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Fed May Not Raise Rates Again in October, Stocks and Currency Both Rise, Up 4.2 Points to 31.788
paras: 隨著市場對美國繼續升息的預期轉弱，台股持續攻高，今(5)日飆漲多達1236點，台北匯市也同步走強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收在31.788元，升值4.2分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值18.18億美元。
新台幣今日以31.81元、升值2分開出後，最高來到31.74元，全日高低價差7分。
觀察主要亞幣，美元指數波動大，目前反彈約0.2%，泰銖貶逾0.6%，人民幣和星元貶0.05%左右，日元和韓元處平盤左右，新台幣收升0.13%。
聯準會預計10月27日舉行會議，元大投顧說明，聯準會副主席認為可能需要更多時間評估是否需要進一步升息，負責金融監理的副主席鮑曼也表示，需要更多時間了解經濟的基本趨勢，因此，市場對再度升息的擔憂緩解，目前台股關注議題回到9月營收和季報公告，個股強弱分明。
國泰證期研究部也指出，美國9月非農就業僅增2.9萬人，遠低於預期8.4萬人，且前值遭下修，失業率升至4.2%、時薪放緩，使市場對聯準會在10月底升息至少1碼的機率從64.2%一口氣降至22.7%。
惟10年期美債殖利率逆勢升至5.28%，對於台股而言會限制權值股的發揮，預期維持高檔震盪與題材輪動。
paras_en: As market expectations for further US rate hikes weaken, Taiwan’s stock market kept climbing, surging as much as 1,236 points today (Oct 5). The Taipei foreign exchange market also strengthened, with the New Taiwan dollar appreciating throughout the day and closing at 31.788, up 4.2 points. Taipei FX brokers reported a turnover of $1.818 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.81, up 2 points, and peaked at 31.74, with a daily high‑low spread of 7 points.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the US dollar index was volatile, rebounding about 0.2%. The Thai baht fell over 0.6%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each weakened roughly 0.05%, while the Japanese yen and South Korean won stayed near flat. The New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.13%.

The Fed is slated to meet on Oct. 27. According to Yuanta Securities, the Fed’s vice‑chair said more time may be needed to assess whether further hikes are required, and the vice‑chair for financial supervision, Bowman, also said more time is needed to understand the economy’s underlying trend. Consequently, concerns about another hike have eased, and market focus on Taiwan stocks has shifted back to September revenue and earnings releases, with clear winners and losers among individual stocks.

Cathay Securities’ research team noted that US non‑farm payrolls rose by only 22,900 in September, far below the forecast of 84,000 and a revision of the prior figure. The unemployment rate rose to 4.2% and wage growth slowed, cutting the market’s estimate of a 1‑point Fed hike by the end of October from 64.2% to 22.7%.

However, the 10‑year US Treasury yield rose against the trend to 5.28%, which could limit the performance of large‑cap stocks in Taiwan. The market is expected to stay in a high‑level range with sector rotation continuing.

items.title: 歐元重挫至17個月新低 美元走強引發全球匯市波動
items.title_en: Euro Plummets to 17-Month Low as Strong Dollar Sparks Global FX Turmoil
paras: 受歐元區政治動盪與財政風險加劇影響，歐元兌美元於亞市周一(5日)盤中一度重挫 0.8% 至 1.1161，創下自 2025 年 5 月以來的 17 個月新低。
亞洲現貨市場的快速資金大量拋售歐元換取美元，推動價格突破止損點並引發期權相關賣盤，進一步加劇跌勢。同時，美元指數升至 102.48 左右，亞洲貨幣、英鎊與日元普遍承壓。
針對法國與歐元區的局勢，外匯分析公司 Spectra Markets 交易總裁Brent Donnelly表示：「許多人原本預期隨著 2027 年 4 月大選臨近，法國政治效應會在今冬升級，但這波交易現在已經爆發。」他補充稱：「有鑑於政權即將更迭，法國政府目前做出的預算承諾可信度並不高，目前尚不清楚該如何修復局勢。」
摩根大通包括Meera Chandan在內的策略師團隊則指出，歐元尚未完全反映法國國債市場擴大的利差與相關尾部風險。他們在報告中寫道：「歐元兌瑞郎匯率依然偏高，未來可能繼續向下調整。」
馬來亞銀行資深外匯策略師Fiona Lim分析：「儘管美國勞工報告偏弱，但美元似乎已擺脫影響；在法國信用違約交換(CDS)利差大幅擴大後，市場焦點轉向了歐元區。」
她指出，這引發了對歐元區其他高負債邊緣經濟體財政狀況的關注，從而進一步支撐了美元的強勢。
paras_en: Affected by political turmoil and heightened fiscal risks in the euro area, the euro fell sharply against the dollar in Asian markets on Monday (the 5th), dropping 0.8% intraday to 1.1161, a 17‑month low not seen since May 2025.

Rapid fund outflows in the Asian spot market saw massive euro sales for dollars, pushing the price through stop‑loss levels and triggering related option sell‑offs, further deepening the decline. At the same time, the dollar index rose to around 102.48, putting pressure on Asian currencies, the pound and the yen.

Commenting on the situation in France and the euro area, Brent Donnelly, President of Trading at forex analysis firm Spectra Markets, said: “Many had expected the French political effect to intensify this winter as the April 2027 election approached, but this wave of trading has now erupted.” He added: “Given the impending change of government, the credibility of the budget commitments made by the French government is low, and it is unclear how the situation can be repaired.”

A strategy team at JPMorgan, including Meera Chandan, noted that the euro has not yet fully priced in the widening spread in French sovereign bonds and the associated tail risk. In their report they wrote: “The euro/CHF exchange rate remains elevated and may continue to be adjusted downward in the future.”

Senior FX strategist Fiona Lim of Maybank analyzed: “Even though the US labor report was weak, the dollar seems to have shrugged off the impact; after French credit default swap (CDS) spreads widened dramatically, market focus shifted to the euro area.”
She pointed out that this has sparked concerns about the fiscal health of other highly indebted fringe economies in the euro zone, further underpinning the dollar’s strength.

美國公債收益率上升，導致澳洲公債相對於美國公債的收益率優勢縮減至一年多以來最低，並據上週五消息人士表示，外交斡旋前景暗淡，若美國恢復大規模軍事襲擊，伊朗醞釀強力報復來迎戰美國新攻擊，提升避險情緒，打壓澳幣和紐元至數月低點附近，而且市場對法國債務問題的擔憂加劇，拖累歐元兌美元下滑至1.1220低點。

能源價格走高，引發全球債券市場風暴，英國公債收益率創1998年以來新高，突顯市場擔憂英國財政狀況，上週五推低英鎊兌美元至1.3178低點。隨著歐洲部分債務負擔沉重國家財政前景憂慮加劇，拖累歐元兌英鎊，而且美國就業數據弱損及美元，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3255高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3240-60，支撐於1.3140-60。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Last week two senior Federal Reserve officials argued that more data should be gathered before deciding the next monetary‑policy move, prompting market participants to stop betting on a rate hike at the Fed’s late‑October meeting. However, reports of the United States sending additional troops and an aircraft carrier to the Middle East and China suspending oil‑product exports sent oil prices soaring and U.S. Treasury yields climbing to their highest level since 2002, supporting the dollar near a 17‑month high. Meanwhile, Japan’s August unemployment rate rose to 2.5% according to Friday’s data, the job‑seeking ratio held steady at 1.18, and Tokyo’s September core CPI accelerated 2.7% year‑on‑year – the biggest rise in ten months and above expectations. This figure is widely seen as a leading indicator of nationwide inflation and will be one of the factors the Bank of Japan (BOJ) considers when updating its quarterly inflation forecast at its October 29‑30 policy meeting, providing a rationale for further rate hikes. Although bets on consecutive BOJ hikes have faded, many still expect a hike in December, which could boost the yen and pull USD/JPY down from its 158.21 peak.

According to Japan’s Finance Minister Shiroi, Japan is no longer in deflation, so there is no need for overly accommodative policy aimed at chasing higher inflation, which should support the yen. At the same time, the U.S. Labor Department reported that September non‑farm payrolls rose by only 29,000 jobs and the unemployment rate climbed to 4.2%, while average hourly earnings edged up 0.1% from the previous month – all below expectations. August job gains were revised down to 133,000, and August factory orders rose 0.1% in line with forecasts, but durable‑goods orders fell 0.1% month‑over‑month, missing estimates. These weak data caused the rate‑futures market to slash the probability of a Fed hike in October to below 20%, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.94, though the market still expects the Fed to maintain a hawkish stance, helping the dollar recover some losses. The dollar‑yen resistance today is projected at 157.70‑90 with support at 156.70‑90.
EUR/USD

Rising U.S. Treasury yields have narrowed the yield advantage of Australian bonds over U.S. bonds to the lowest level in more than a year. Sources said on Friday that diplomatic prospects look bleak; if the United States resumes large‑scale military strikes, Iran is poised to launch a strong retaliation against new U.S. attacks, heightening risk‑off sentiment and pushing the Australian and New Zealand dollars toward multi‑month lows. At the same time, growing concerns over France’s debt issues have weighed on the euro, pulling EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1220.

Eurostat data released later showed that the Eurozone’s September Harmonised CPI (HICP) preliminary reading rose to 3.8% on the back of higher fuel and natural‑gas prices, pushing overall inflation further above the European Central Bank’s 2% target and adding pressure for another rate hike. Bundesbank President Nagel said strong export demand and government investment are driving Germany’s growth forecast to about 1% this year – roughly double the latest estimate – and weak U.S. employment data have hurt the dollar, lifting the euro to a high of 1.1285. The euro‑dollar resistance today is estimated at 1.1250‑70 with support at 1.1160‑80.
GBP/USD

items.title: 升息預期撐美元 摩根士丹利改口看多 DXY年底上看102
items.title_en: Rising Rate Expectations Support the Dollar, Morgan Stanley Reverses Course to Bullish, DXY Expected to Reach 102 by Year-End
paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，投資銀行摩根士丹利 (Morgan Stanley) 外匯策略團隊於近期發布的研究報告中公開承認預測失誤，表示原先看空美元的理由已不復存在，並同步調升今年底至 2027 年的美元指數與主要貨幣目標價。
衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣價值的美元指數 (DXY) 近期強勢走高，本週攀升至 101 附近，創近八週新高。美元走強雖提升了美國民眾海外消費的購買力，卻也令美國出口商品成本上升。近期連美國總統川普在會晤日本首相高市早苗時，亦公開提及對日元過度貶值的關切。
由 David S. Adams 領軍的小摩外匯策略團隊在報告中坦言：「我們錯了！」
小摩團隊先前預期美元將於今年下半年持續下行、年底觸底，並至 2027 年轉強，該預測建立在美國與全球利差將縮小、聯準會 (Fed) 暫停升息而其他央行追趕的假設上。
然而，居高不下的能源價格與強勁的美國經濟數據，促使聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 展現偏鷹派政策立場，使美國進一步升息的可能性大幅增加。
根據 CME FedWatch 利率期貨數據顯示，市場預期 Fed 於 10 月會議升息 1 碼 (至 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間)) 的機率已達 68.6%，12 月再度升息 1 碼的機率亦超過五成。
摩根士丹利指出，市場仍有相當大的空間繼續推升升息預期，這將為美元提供穩固的支撐力量。
因應基本面變化，摩根士丹利全面調升美元目標價：

將今年底美元指數預測由原先的 96 大幅上修至 102；
歐元兌美元由 1.20 下調至 1.12 美元；
英鎊兌美元由 1.38 下調至 1.30 美元；
美元兌日元則由 157 上調至 159 日元。


展望 2027 年年中，隨著歐洲政治與財政疑慮再現，預期美元指數將上看 104，歐元兌美元可能進一步走軟至 1.10 美元。在交易策略上，團隊建議可於美元兌日元 158 時建立多頭部位，目標價看 163 日元，停損價設於 150 日元。
不過，摩根士丹利亦提出幾點風險警示。
首先，美元此波強勢主要集中於對抗日元、歐元及瑞士法郎等低利率融資貨幣，而澳元及挪威克朗等商品貨幣仍將維持相對強勢。
其次，部分貶值預期已反映於市場期權價格中，變動幅度可能相對有限。
最後，政治與政策等突發事件仍可能引發震盪，例如關稅政策宣佈或外匯干預等黑天鵝事件，都可能引發美元多頭部位的連鎖停損賣壓。
事實上，不僅是小摩，一些投行也紛紛看多美元。
德國商業銀行分析師 Thu Lan Nguyen 指出，Fed 9 月一致決議升息，暫時恢復了市場對其政策可信度的信心，並支撐美元。該行因此將今年底歐元兌美元預測從 1.17 下修至 1.15，預期 Fed 年底前還會升息一次；此前該行預估 Fed 將維持利率不變。
展望 2027 年，德國商業銀行認為，美國及歐元區的升息預期都可能下修，但美元承受的壓力將更大，歐元兌美元可望逐步回升。

paras_en: Morgan Stanley’s foreign‑exchange strategy team publicly admitted a forecasting error in a recent research report, stating that the reasons for a short position on the dollar no longer exist and simultaneously raised its year‑end to 2027 targets for the dollar index and major currencies.

The dollar index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, has recently surged, climbing to around 101 this week and setting a new high for nearly eight weeks. While a stronger dollar boosts the purchasing power of U.S. consumers abroad, it also raises the cost of U.S. exports. President Trump recently voiced concerns about the excessive depreciation of the yen during a meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.
Led by David S. Adams, the Morgan Stanley FX team admitted, “We were wrong!”

The team had previously expected the dollar to continue falling in the second half of the year, bottoming out by year‑end and strengthening by 2027, based on assumptions that U.S. and global interest‑rate spreads would narrow, the Fed would pause rate hikes while other central banks would catch up.

However, persistently high energy prices and robust U.S. economic data have prompted the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to adopt a hawkish stance, greatly increasing the likelihood of further U.S. rate hikes.

CME FedWatch futures data show that the market now assigns a 68.6% probability to a 25‑basis‑point hike at the October meeting (raising the policy range to 4.00%–4.25%) and more than 50% probability of another 25‑basis‑point hike in December.
Morgan Stanley notes that there remains substantial room for the market to further lift rate‑hike expectations, which would provide solid support for the dollar.
In response to changing fundamentals, Morgan Stanley has fully revised its dollar targets:

The year‑end DXY forecast has been sharply raised from 96 to 102; the EUR/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.20 to 1.12; the GBP/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.38 to 1.30; and the USD/JPY forecast has been raised from 157 to 159.

Looking ahead to mid‑2027, as European political and fiscal concerns resurface, the dollar index is expected to rise to 104, with the euro potentially softening further to 1.10. In trading terms, the team recommends taking a long position at USD/JPY 158 with a target of 163 and a stop‑loss at 150.
Nonetheless, Morgan Stanley issued several risk warnings.

First, the dollar’s recent strength is mainly focused on countering low‑rate currencies such as the yen, euro, and Swiss franc, while commodity currencies like the AUD and NOK will remain relatively strong.
Second, some depreciation expectations are already reflected in market option prices, so the upside may be limited.
Finally, political and policy shocks—such as tariff announcements or foreign‑exchange interventions—could trigger chain stop‑loss selling of dollar long positions.
In fact, it is not only Morgan Stanley; other investment banks are also bullish on the dollar.

German commercial bank analyst Thu Lan Nguyen noted that the Fed’s unanimous rate hike in September temporarily restored market confidence in its policy credibility and supported the dollar. The bank therefore lowered its year‑end EUR/USD forecast from 1.17 to 1.15 and expects another Fed hike before year‑end, after previously predicting a pause.

Looking to 2027, the German commercial bank believes that U.S. and euro‑area rate‑hike expectations may be cut, but the dollar will face greater pressure, and the euro may gradually recover against the dollar.

The bank expects the Fed to keep rates unchanged after the December 2023 hike until the end of 2027, and if the Middle‑East crisis eases and inflationary shocks subside, the Fed could also cut rates before the end of 2027; the White House’s influence on Fed independence is another pressure source for the dollar.
(Duplicate paragraph 18 and 19 omitted for brevity)

MUFG’s September 18 report stated that Fed hikes and hawkish signals support the dollar, while the Bank of Japan’s post‑hike stance fell short of market expectations, leaving short‑term upside for USD/JPY. However, MUFG did not significantly raise its dollar forecast, still projecting a 4.2% decline in the DXY by Q2 2027 from the report’s level, as other G10 central banks may continue to hike, potentially preventing spreads from widening favorably for the dollar.

Regarding the yen, MUFG expects the Bank of Japan to hike again in January and June 2027, raising the policy rate to 1.75%. Thus, while USD/JPY may continue to rise in the short term, subsequent hikes and intervention risk will likely cap gains; the bank expects buying pressure to weaken before the 160‑yen breakout.
